hero.description: Coordinated agents that keep client plans current as goals, markets, and regulations change.

problem.title: Plans that go stale
problem.description: Financial plans are often built once and left static. Goals change, markets move, and advisors spend hours re-gathering data before every review.

outcome.title: A plan that keeps up
outcome.description: Prime Agentic continuously reconciles a client's goals and holdings, surfacing the changes that matter so advisors focus on the conversation, not the paperwork.

features.title: Continuous reconciliation
features.description: Agents reconcile holdings against goals and flag drift.

features.title: Scenario modeling
features.description: Model life events and market changes against a plan.

features.title: Review preparation
features.description: Summarize changes and surface next-best actions before each review.

features.title: Goal tracking
features.description: Track progress toward retirement, education, and other goals.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Agents gather goals, holdings, and constraints into a living plan.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: Agents reconcile data, run scenarios, and prepare review materials.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.description: As goals or markets change, agents update the plan and flag what needs attention.

useCases.title: Independent advisors
useCases.description: Spend less time on data gathering and more on client conversations.

useCases.title: Wealth management firms
useCases.description: Keep a growing book of client plans current across reviewers.

useCases.title: Retirement planning
useCases.description: Track progress toward retirement goals and flag shortfalls early.
